The Indian Air Force is the air arm of the Indian Armed Forces. It is responsible for securing Indian airspace and conducting aerial warfare during conflicts.

The AFCAT 02/2026 programme is a recruitment drive by the Indian Air Force to select officers for various branches. The programme aims to provide opportunities for Indian citizens to join the air force as officers.
